purpose: Test whether a label-blind PPARG MD frame panel creates reproducible functional complementarity and a genuinely difficult receptor-subset landscape before any large QUBO or hardware experiment.

ligand_panel.selection_rule: For each label, hash-order scaffold groups, then select the lowest allocation-rank ligand from each of the first 80 groups.

functional_analysis_preregistration.set_aggregation: receptor-wise outer-train rank-normalized minimum docking score
functional_analysis_preregistration.robust_utility: equal-weight mean of primary median-seed BEDROC20, mean individual-seed BEDROC20, and worst individual-seed BEDROC20
functional_analysis_preregistration.strong_greedy: best of all singleton starts followed by best-improvement additions and one-swap local search, with lexicographic ties
functional_analysis_preregistration.exact_oracle: enumerate all receptor subsets for each k from one through six
functional_analysis_preregistration.decision: Only a reproducible train gap with non-negative outer holdout transfer may authorize a separately frozen Stage33 pairwise or auxiliary QUBO model.

execution.environment: reuse qubo-receptor-md for MDTraj snapshot extraction and qubo-unidock-stage07 for ProDy, Meeko, and Uni-Dock; never mutate either environment
execution.trajectory_requirement: extract Stage32 into an independent workspace and provide the existing Stage28b workspace through --trajectory-root; the remote wrapper auto-discovers it when possible
execution.resume_contract: reuse a batch only when the protocol signature, score file, pose hashes, pose-integrity audit, and warning adjudication all pass

interpretation_boundary: Stage32 is a train-only PPARG MD-frame functional pilot. It may determine whether a new MD-derived subset landscape deserves a separately frozen Stage33 QUBO model, but it cannot alter prior confirmation failures, establish prospective efficacy, use protected validation or test data, demonstrate quantum speedup, or establish quantum advantage.
